name: ConsentLayer
description:
ConsentLayer helps website owners manage visitor consent and cookie preferences across major privacy frameworks, including GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD. It provides tools to display customizable consent banners, manage script blocking, and record visitor consent choices.

With the ConsentLayer Connector, setting up consent management is as easy as having a conversation. Connect ConsentLayer to Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or your preferred Claude interface, and let AI assist with your consent setup. Instead of manually navigating settings or categorizing scripts by hand, you can simply ask Claude to help configure ConsentLayer for your site.

What Claude can do with this connector:

Guided Setup: Claude can create your site profile and apply initial configuration settings automatically.

Tracker Scanning: Claude can scan your website for third-party scripts (such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel) and help organize them into functional categories.

Banner Customization: Claude can configure localized consent banners designed to adjust display rules based on visitor regions.

Code Integration: Claude can generate setup code and assist with adding the lightweight banner script directly to your project codebase.

Key Features:

Streamlined AI Setup: Connect Claude to assist with site configuration without needing to manually copy API keys.

Conditional Script Blocking: Designed to block configured analytics and advertising scripts until a visitor provides consent.

Framework Integration: Includes options to support Google Consent Mode v2 and Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals.

Consent Logging: Records visitor consent preferences for viewing and CSV export.

Let Claude assist with your cookie banner configuration so you can focus on building your site.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ConsentLayer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ConsentLayer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.consentlayer.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ConsentLayer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ConsentLayer lists 59 MCP tools, including add_custom_service, add_geolocation_group_from_template, add_service_cookie, approve_unrecognized_script, check_installation, configure_do_not_sell, configure_from_scan, create_category, create_geolocation_group, create_site, delete_category, and delete_geolocation_group.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ConsentLayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ConsentLayer in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
ConsentLayer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ConsentLayer is developed by ConsentLayer. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
